My experience at this shop was very disappointing. I bought a pair of JoyBean brand sandals for ₹1,500. The shopkeeper initially quoted ₹1,900, and after bargaining, I purchased them for ₹1,500. However, when I returned home and checked the brand’s official website, I found that the MRP was ₹1,399 and the selling price was ₹1,245. Moreover, the original price tag had been removed from the item.

It appears that inflating the price first and then reducing it during bargaining is a tactic used to make customers feel satisfied, while still giving the shopkeeper an unfair advantage.

This practice is misleading and unfair. I advise others to avoid such fraudulent shops. If you do visit, make sure to check the price tag and do not fall for the shopkeeper’s sweet talk.
